description: The sorted formula \(\forall z:s\,\bot\) holds exactly when the ambient predicate \(P_s\) is empty.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Model.all_falsum_iff_empty.{u, v, w}
  {L : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Signature} {U : Type w}
  (M : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Model L U) {n : ℕ} {γ : Fin n → L.Sorts} (s : L.Sorts)
  (a : Fin n → U) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Formula.Realize M
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Formula.all s
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ManySortedLogic.Formula.falsum)
      a ↔
    ¬∃ x, M.sort s x
